ads.title: The MICHELIN Nyonya restaurant
ads.primary: Going to Penang? Auntie Gaik Lean's was the first Nyonya restaurant in Malaysia to earn a MICHELIN Star, and it has kept it every year since. Heirloom recipes, made by hand on Bishop Street, George Town.
ads.headline: Book Auntie's table in Penang
ads.audience: Singapore + Kuala Lumpur, 25–55, planning travel to Penang, dining out

ads.title: Penang this weekend
ads.primary: Penang this weekend? Bring the whole family to Auntie's table. Big tables for ten or more, 60s music and Nyonya cooking made from scratch. Lunch and dinner, Wednesday to Sunday.
ads.headline: Big Nyonya tables in George Town
ads.audience: Singapore + Kuala Lumpur families and groups, travel and family-dining interests

reels.title: Auntie's table
reels.caption:
From the blue shopfront on Bishop Street to Auntie's kitchen and the round tables. One MICHELIN Star, four years running.
